name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including document roots, virtual-host settings, security controls, fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and development certificate generation.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379 with authentication, creates its log directory, and applies required post-configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
